Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that Deepak Tijori was born earlier based on the incorrect logic of comparing director ages at the time of film release, rather than correctly comparing birth years. The logic used was reversed, as being older at film release does not equate to being born earlier. As a result, the Planner incorrectly deduced that Deepak Tijori was born earlier than Harry Piel, despite Harry Piel's birth year being clearly earlier (1892 vs. 1961).
